mapper.select: SELECT sl.schedule_line_id AS scheduleLineId, sl.commission_item_id AS commissionItemId, sl.contract_month_no AS contractMonthNo, sl.expected_amount AS amount FROM fgc.schedule_line sl JOIN fgc.schedule_header sh ON sh.schedule_header_id = sl.schedule_header_id WHERE sh.contract_id = #{contractId} AND sh.payment_stage = #{paymentStage} AND sh.schedule_purpose = 'OPERATIONAL' AND sh.active_yn = true AND sl.line_status <> 'CANCELLED' AND sl.contract_month_no BETWEEN 1 AND #{firstYearMonths}
